housing.summary: No defensible city-centre one-bedroom average was found; live Daft results were treated as listings, not an average. The RTB says a security deposit may not exceed one month of rent. Sources: https://www.daft.ie/property-for-rent/navan-meath https://rtb.ie/renting/rights-responsibilities/security-deposits/

banking.summary: AIB requires an original current photo ID and an original proof of current permanent address issued within the past six months; applicants not resident in Ireland need two proof-of-address documents. Source: https://www.aib.ie/our-products/current-accounts/personal-current-account-identity-requirements
required_docs: original proof of current permanent address issued within the past six months
two proof-of-address documents if not currently resident in Ireland

schools.summary: The Department of Education and Youth provides a map-based school directory, but no Navan-specific international curriculum was grounded. Source: https://www.gov.ie/en/department-of-education/services/find-a-school/

legal_admin.summary: People from outside the EU, EEA, UK and Switzerland who intend to stay more than 90 days must register their permission with Immigration Service Delivery within 90 days of arrival and make an appointment for first registration at Burgh Quay. Source: https://www.irishimmigration.ie/registering-your-immigration-permission/how-to-register-your-immigration-permission-for-the-first-time/information-on-registering-your-immigration-permission-for-the-first-time/
legal_admin.registration_step: Register immigration permission with Immigration Service Delivery within 90 days of arrival; first registration is by appointment at 13-14 Burgh Quay, Dublin 2.

tax_finance.summary: The individual tax reference is the Personal Public Service Number, issued by the Department of Social Protection and used in dealings with Revenue. Adults can apply online through MyWelfare using a MyGovID account and must provide identity, address and reason evidence. Sources: https://www.revenue.ie/en/jobs-and-pensions/personal-public-service-number/index.aspx https://www.gov.ie/en/department-of-social-protection/services/get-a-personal-public-service-pps-number/

transport.summary: Navan is in TFI Zone 4; the adult commuter-bus Zones 1-4 monthly ticket is EUR 206.85. EU/EEA licences remain valid while current and may be exchanged; licences from recognised states can be exchanged when normally resident. HSE medical-card or GP-visit-card applications can be made online with PPS numbers, dates of birth, and income and expense details. Sources: https://www.transportforireland.ie/fares/new-fare-zones/ https://www.ndls.ie/licensed-driver/exchange-my-foreign-driving-licence.html https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/medical-cards/applying/apply/
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences may be used while valid and exchanged for an Irish licence; a licence from a recognised state must be exchanged after taking up normal residence to continue driving under that licence.
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply online to the HSE for a medical card or GP visit card and provide PPS numbers, dates of birth, and income and expense details.
